title: API Keys → Create Key asks only for a name, and the key silently gets the 90-day default expiry the Authentication policy sets — show the expiry in the dialog and let the admin choose it within the policy (hotcrm#2194 T2-U21)
body:
## 维护者速读

- **事由：** 创建 API 密钥只问名称，密钥悄悄得到 90 天的默认有效期，列表里出现管理员从没选过的「2027/1/18」。
- **要做：** 18.0.0 的认证设置已有完整的 API 密钥策略（默认/最长有效期、闲置过期），在创建对话框里显示该默认值，并允许在策略范围内选择。
- **完成标准：** 创建时看得到、改得了有效期。

Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: the maintainer's ruling on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194, recorded there at `6354968262` (the director seat, posting from the maintainer's account): 「25251 B hotcrm B」, 2026-10-23T01:05:47Z. That is letter B for all three rounds, exactly as the seat recommended, and it adopts **T2-U21**. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 1 (`os-elon-musk`, session `session_014xanhPEmGTMTfVH4UokwJT`) under objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's *After the ruling*. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Grade:** triage's. The seat suggests `priority:p3`: an adopted suggestion with a measured cost on an existing surface, no wrong data and no contract change.

**Reader (who acts):** objectstack triage routes and grades it. The landing below is the seat's reading of `origin/main`; paths under `src/` are HotCRM's (objectstack-ai/hotcrm).

## Governing text

- The ruling above. Per objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's own governing text, this item is an adopted suggestion through filing gate ②, not a defect card, and a platform or console landing is changed there, never re-implemented in HotCRM: 「平台相关的功能，应该尽量先改平台。」 (maintainer, 2026-10-18, ledger `6245607810`).

## Why (measured)

- **Page / persona:** Setup → API Keys → Create Key, the system administrator.
- **Now:** only a Name field; the key gets a 90-day expiry (from Authentication → key lifetime) the dialog never mentions. The list then shows "1/18/2027", which the admin never chose.
- **18.0.0:** unchanged, though Authentication now has a full API-key policy (default and maximum lifetime, inactivity expiry), so the default the item wants shown exists.
- **Evidence:** objectstack-ai/hotcrm [track 2 report, *UI and UX suggestions*](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/REPORT.md), U-21, [`17-access-api-keys-create.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/17-access-api-keys-create.png); the 18.0.0 reading in [round 2 track 2 report, *UI and UX suggestions*](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/REPORT.md) (the API Keys row), [`18-access-api-keys-create.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/shots/18-access-api-keys-create.png).

## Landing

Read on objectstack `origin/main` `7b047b44`:
- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-api-key.object.ts` `create_api_key` (~:101–126): `params: [{ field: 'name', required: true }]`. Its comment says the route reads `name` and an optional `expires_at` and nothing else.
- The default and the maximum come from the Authentication API-key policy (`plugin-auth`). A chosen expiry beyond the maximum is refused by the route, never clamped silently.

## Done when

- Create Key shows the expiry the key will get, defaulted from the policy, and lets the admin pick another within the policy's maximum.
- A value past the maximum is refused with the policy named.
- Pins on the action's params and on the route's refusal.

**Size:** S.

## Dedupe

Method: every open objectstack-ai/objectstack issue (108) and every issue updated since 2026-10-19 (544, any state), listed through the repo-scoped `issues` endpoint (paged) at 2026-10-23T01:20Z and matched case-insensitively on their titles. Words: `api key`, `expiry`, `lifetime`. 2 hits: #25112 (closed, the Magic Link lifetime) and #24565 (closed, an audit cache lifetime). Not on point. **New.**
